name: Run a repair operation
description: Executes one operation with the venue's authority. Eir only. Without `user`: v/ops/user/list|info (this venue's users), v/ops/venue/adapters|show-config (its setup), v/ops/venue/adapter/enable|disable|configure, v/ops/mcp/refresh|tools-list (its MCP servers), v/ops/secret/list (the venue's secret names, never values), v/ops/file/roots|list|stat|read (the logs root holds Tau's log, brightside.log), v/ops/brightside/storage (compaction at the next start), v/ops/brightside/restart (the venue stops and starts again inside the app; the startup check repairs the gods), v/ops/brightside/relaunch (a new instance takes over from this one). With `user`: runs the operation inside that user's namespace on their behalf (user:sudo, this venue's own users only). To look: v/ops/covia/read|list|inspect|slice|aggregate, v/ops/agent/list|info|context|sessions|session-read, v/ops/skills/list|read, v/ops/secret/list (names only), v/ops/scheduler/list, v/ops/hitl/list, v/ops/oauth/status. To repair: v/ops/agent/resume {agentId} lets an agent stopped by a fault run again, v/ops/agent/update {agentId, config} changes its configuration (a recursive merge: vectors such as tools replace, maps merge, a null value removes a key), v/ops/agent/reload-context|compact-session|cancel-task|delete-session|suspend, v/ops/brightside/upgrade-agent {agentId} brings an agent Tau made onto Tau's current setup (its standard parts only), v/ops/skills/import, v/ops/brightside/delete-skill, v/ops/covia/write|copy|delete. Without `user`, v/ops/job/cancel with the `id` of an Inbox request Eir made itself withdraws it, once it no longer needs an answer; no other job. Anything else is refused, and the venue's own agents are out of reach. Anything that changes state needs `reason`, and is reported to Odin with its input and outcome as soon as it is done; the output then carries report {address, id}. Every run is a recorded job.

operation.description: The full operation path, e.g. v/ops/agent/resume.

input.description: The operation's own input, exactly as its schema describes.

user.description: Optional: a user DID of this venue. When present the operation runs inside that user's namespace on their behalf, and must be one of the namespace operations.

reason.description: Required for any operation that changes state: the fault, its cause and why this repair. Odin receives it with the outcome. Up to 2000 characters.

output.description: The operation's own output; after a change, with report {address, id}: the task that told Odin.
